hornbill: A GREAT HORNBILL perched on a branch in side profile. Its bill is a huge downcurved yellow bill, and lying ON TOP OF THE BILL is a SECOND SEPARATE STRUCTURE: a large hollow FLAT-TOPPED CASQUE like a wide yellow helmet or an upturned box sitting along the whole upper bill, with a black front edge. Body glossy BLACK, neck and head YELLOW, a broad WHITE BAR across the folded black wing, a long WHITE TAIL crossed by ONE BLACK BAND, and a red eye. The flat-topped casque on top of the bill is the entire point. NOT a toucan, whose bill is smooth and has nothing on top of it
sandcat: A sand cat standing on all four legs, a SMALL STOCKY SHORT-LEGGED pale sandy desert cat with a VERY BROAD FLAT WIDE HEAD, and ENORMOUS BROAD TRIANGULAR EARS - each ear as wide as it is tall, set LOW DOWN ON THE SIDES OF THE HEAD and angled OUTWARD rather than standing upright on top of the skull, so the head looks unusually wide. Dense pale sandy fur, faint bars on the legs, a black-ringed tail tip. The ears are huge and low and outward-facing
gecko: A tokay gecko clinging to a branch, a plump grey-blue lizard with orange and pale spots, a large blunt head, big round orange eyes with vertical pupils, and wide splayed toes with round adhesive pads. It has EXACTLY FOUR LEGS IN TOTAL: TWO FRONT LEGS and TWO BACK LEGS, no more, and one single tail. Four legs and one tail only
arcticfox: An arctic fox standing on all four legs in thick winter coat, a small compact fox in ONE FLAT UNIFORM PURE WHITE all over its whole body, legs, face and tail, with only a soft clean pale grey used for shading. NO dark patches, NO grey socks, NO black or charcoal areas anywhere on the body or legs. Small rounded ears, short muzzle, dark eyes, black nose, and a very thick bushy pure white tail. Entirely white
arcticfox_j: An arctic fox kit standing on all four legs, a small round fluffy fox cub in ONE FLAT UNIFORM SOFT CREAMY WHITE all over, with only a clean pale grey for shading. NO dark patches, NO grey or charcoal smudges anywhere, NO dirty markings. An oversized round head, small rounded ears, big dark eyes, a short muzzle, stubby legs and a thick fluffy tail. Clean, soft and uniformly pale
bat: A fruit bat, a flying fox, CLINGING UPRIGHT to a branch with its body vertical and HEAD UPRIGHT AT THE TOP, wings folded closed against its sides like a cloak. Its head is clearly and correctly drawn: a FOX-LIKE HEAD with a long pointed muzzle, a black nose, large round dark eyes and two upright pointed ears, russet-brown fur on the head and shoulders, darker brown wing membranes. Head upright and the right way up, facing the viewer in three-quarter view
cheetah_j: A cheetah cub in FULL SIDE PROFILE VIEW facing left, standing on all four legs so the whole length of its back is visible from the side. A THICK SILVER-GREY MANTLE OF LONG SHAGGY FUR runs along the top of its neck, shoulders and back like a crest or cape, clearly seen against the profile. Tawny spotted body, black tear stripes from eye to mouth, small round head, long legs, long tail. Side view so the mantle along the back reads as fur, not as a bib
pallascat: A Pallas's cat sitting, an extremely stocky SHORT-LEGGED small wildcat made round by very dense long fur, with a VERY WIDE FLAT FACE and a FLAT-TOPPED HEAD, and TINY LOW ROUNDED EARS set far apart LOW ON THE SIDES OF THE HEAD, barely projecting above the skull at all so the head looks flat and wide. Pale silver-ochre fur with white-tipped guard hairs, dark bars on the flanks, dark rings on a short thick tail, white whisker patches and ROUND pupils. Squat, flat-faced and grumpy
fishingcat: A fishing cat standing on all four legs at a waterside, a ROBUST STOCKY SHORT-LEGGED medium wildcat with a deep chest and a large broad head, olive-grey fur marked with rows of SMALL DARK SOLID SPOTS ARRANGED IN NEAT LENGTHWISE LINES along the back and flanks, dark stripes running back over the crown, small rounded ears set low and dark on the back, a white muzzle and chin, and a SHORT THICK TAIL about a third of body length ringed with dark bands
cloudedleopard: A clouded leopard walking along a branch, a LONG-BODIED SHORT-LEGGED cat with an EXTREMELY LONG THICK TAIL as long as its whole body, and a grey-tan coat marked with LARGE IRREGULAR CLOUD-SHAPED BLOTCHES: big pale-centred patches each outlined by a dark curved border, quite unlike round spots, across the flanks and back. Small rounded head, long thick neck, black bars behind the ears, and very large paws
bobcat: A bobcat standing on all four legs, a medium tawny-brown wildcat with dark spots and short bars on its legs and belly, a broad face framed by a PRONOUNCED FLARED CHEEK RUFF of longer fur like sideburns, upright ears with SHORT BLACK TUFTS at the tips and white spots on the black backs, and above all a VERY SHORT BOBBED STUMPY TAIL only a few inches long, black on top and WHITE UNDERNEATH
rustyspottedcat: A rusty-spotted cat, the SMALLEST WILD CAT IN THE WORLD, standing on all four legs, a TINY delicate cat with a small rounded head, VERY LARGE EYES relative to its face, short grey-fawn fur marked with lines of soft RUSTY REDDISH-BROWN BLOTCHES running lengthwise along the back and flanks, two dark streaks on each cheek, small rounded ears, slim short legs and a short plain tail. Tiny and fine-boned
kodkod: A kodkod, also called the guina, one of the smallest wild cats, standing on all four legs, a very small cat with THICK DENSE FUR, a SMALL ROUNDED HEAD with a short muzzle and small round ears, warm ochre-brown fur covered ALL OVER in SMALL DENSE ROUND BLACK SPOTS, black speckling on the head and dark streaks on the cheeks, sturdy oversized paws, and a SHORT THICK BUSHY TAIL RINGED WITH DARK BANDS
asiangoldencat: An Asian golden cat standing on all four legs, a medium solidly built cat with a PLAIN UNMARKED UNIFORM FOXY GOLDEN-RED COAT with no spots and no rosettes anywhere on the body, a small head carrying BOLD WHITE-AND-BLACK FACIAL STRIPES running from the inner corner of each eye up over the crown and white streaks along the cheeks, small rounded ears dark on the back, and a long tail whose LAST THIRD IS WHITE UNDERNEATH and often carried curled up
andeancat: An Andean cat standing on rocks, a small stocky high-mountain cat with LONG THICK SOFT ASH-GREY FUR, marked with RUSTY BROWN AND DARK GREY BLOTCHES AND VERTICAL BAR-LIKE STRIPES down its flanks and across its shoulders, two dark bars on each cheek, a black nose, large rounded ears, and a VERY THICK LONG BUSHY TAIL ringed with SIX TO NINE BROAD DARK BANDS and a pale tip. The huge banded fluffy tail is its most distinctive feature
jaguarundi: A jaguarundi walking, an unusual cat that looks more like an OTTER OR A WEASEL than a cat: a VERY LONG LOW SLENDER BODY on SHORT LEGS, with a SMALL FLATTENED NARROW HEAD, SMALL ROUNDED EARS SET LOW AND WIDE APART, a short muzzle, and a VERY LONG THIN TAIL nearly as long as the body. Its coat is COMPLETELY PLAIN AND UNIFORM chestnut-brown with NO spots, NO stripes, NO rosettes and NO markings of any kind anywhere
coyote: A coyote standing on all four legs, a slender wild canid with SHORT TO MEDIUM LEGS IN NORMAL DOG PROPORTION - the body clearly deeper than the legs are long, NOT long-legged or leggy - with a lean grizzled grey-buff body, rusty-tan legs and ears, a narrow pointed muzzle, large upright pointed ears, yellow eyes, and a thick BUSHY BLACK-TIPPED TAIL carried low and down. Compact and low-slung, not tall
